prompt_text:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, photorealistic premium television commercial with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture and cool blue-gray tones, starting exactly from <Picture 1>: a medium close-up of the young man with short black hair, a white earbud, a black backpack strap over his unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt and gray T-shirt, standing in three-quarter profile at the window of the sliding door in the right side wall of a subway carriage, facing left toward the glass; behind him on the right the carriage runs lengthwise with its ceiling rail, hand straps and poles, and two young men stand in the aisle sharing one phone. The layout, the door and the light stay exactly as in <Picture 1>. The train moves steadily; thin tunnel lights streak past in the door window. His performance is restrained and happens in this order: he turns his head slightly to the right and his eyes go to the two young men behind him, who glance at each other and smile quietly over the phone; his gaze pauses on them for a moment, as if he would like to join; then his eyes lower and drift away from them; the corners of his mouth relax and soften very slightly, a fleeting disappointment rather than sadness; he releases a small breath through his nose, his shoulders settle, and he turns back to the window and looks at his faint reflection in the glass. He blinks once, naturally, during the turn. His lips stay closed and still the whole time; he does not speak. Both eyes stay level and symmetrical, pupils aimed at the same target, and his facial proportions stay unchanged as his head turns; he never looks into the lens. In the background the two young men move on their own timing, one scrolling with his thumb, the other shifting his weight with the train; their heads and shoulders stay clear and stable even though they are softly out of focus. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward his face and the reflection. There is no readable text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: A continuous low subway rumble and rail clatter with ventilation hiss, the faint creak of hand straps, a quiet indistinct murmur from the two young men talking softly in turns without intelligible words, and his small breath.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
